name: LiveAgent
oneLiner: All-in-one help desk from Quality Unit with live chat, ticketing, a built-in call center, social channels and an AI chatbot.
bestFor: Small and mid-size teams that want chat, email, phone and social support plus AI in one affordable help desk.

updates.text: LiveAgent rolled out its AI Chatbot (powered by FlowHunt, also built by Quality Unit) in Q1 2025; it runs from the existing chat button with no separate widget.
LiveAgent announced an AI Answer Generator in its August 2025 monthly update.

features: Universal inbox for email, live chat, phone and social messages
Built-in call center with IVR, call routing and call recording
AI Chatbot that answers from your content and detects the customer's language
AI Answer Improver writing assistant for agents
Automation rules, ticket distribution and SLAs

AI on every plan: AI chatbot, AI Answer Assistant drafts, AI autoresponder, AI ticket summaries and an AI spam filter, running on your own AI provider account (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or FlowHunt)
Social channels (Facebook, Instagram, X, Viber, WhatsApp, Telegram), calls, reports, SLA rules and CSAT surveys from the Team plan
Free setup and migration from Zendesk, Freshdesk or Help Scout; data centers in the EU, US or Singapore

pricing.text: Per agent per month, regular prices: Starter $15 billed annually ($19 monthly, up to 5 agents), Team $29 annually ($35 monthly, up to 15 agents), Business $49 annually ($59 monthly); Enterprise flat $3,199/month billed annually ($3,999 monthly) with 80 agents included. Special offer prices ($11, $22, $38 annually) for trials or quotes started by November 22, 2026, locked while you keep the plan. 30-day free trial, no credit card. No LiveAgent fee for AI: you pay your AI provider (about 2-4 cents a chat by LiveAgent's estimate). Phone numbers and minutes are billed by your phone provider.

notes: liveagent.com/pricing was read directly in November 2026 (tier names changed from Small/Medium/Large to Starter/Team/Business). Original said 'Free plan available' — the pricing page lists only paid plans and a 30-day trial, so dropped. Dropped 'fastest live chat widget' claim (unverifiable). AI Answer Generator date is from the 2025 wrap-up summary of the August 2025 update. G2 rating from G2 search snippets and the badge on LiveAgent's pricing page (g2.com returns 403 to fetches).
pros: Low entry price for a full help desk, with published per-agent plans
Built-in call center with IVR and call routing on Team and higher, so phone lines sit in the same inbox as chat and email
AI chatbot and AI reply drafts on every plan with no LiveAgent fee for AI
30-day free trial with no credit card, and free migration from Zendesk, Freshdesk or Help Scout
Rated 4.5 out of 5 on G2 from more than 1,500 reviews

cons.text: No free plan; a 30-day trial, then a paid plan
Starter has no social channels, call center or reporting; those start on Team
AI runs on your own AI provider account, so AI usage is a second bill from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or FlowHunt
Phone numbers and call minutes are billed by your phone provider
A general help desk with no restaurant-specific tools such as review replies or loyalty offers
